clips.title: The story
paras: Aid For The Refugees centers on the displaced survivors of Ban'aethal, a settlement deep within Shadowgale Forest that was suddenly evacuated in the middle of the night. With their home falling into the sky and the surrounding wilderness grown far too perilous to enter, the refugees rely on brave travelers to recover the belongings they had to leave behind.

Aid for the Refugees is an appeal for assistance from Ealaane and her fellow displaced villagers. Having narrowly fled their homes deep in Shadowgale Forest, the survivors have gathered together with almost nothing to their names, hoping a passing traveler will brave the dangers they left behind.

The settlement of Ban'aethal met an unthinkable fate in the dead of night when the village suddenly began to fall into the sky. The bizarre and terrifying calamity gave the inhabitants mere moments to flee, forcing them to abandon their personal possessions as the surrounding woods turned hostile and perilous.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, adventurer, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
